historical_run.model: Not reported: the image-to-3d task response includes no model field. These October 12 runs omitted ai_model, so the model stage followed the API default, meshy-7.1 (the docs' latest). The recipe now pins meshy-7.1. The printability check has no model selection.
historical_run.note: Two live runs, one per language, on October 12, 2026, from fresh copies of the repository, started 5 s apart. Each consumed 20 credits (image-to-3d with should_texture false, STL only), read from consumed_credits; every print-analyze task consumed 0. Model stage 29.2-33.9 s generation with no queue; the thread cut ran locally in about a second; each printability check 12-13 s generation, about 16 s wall; 67.7-70.7 s wall from start to files on disk. Each run was then resumed with the M4 screw, which reused the model task and took 32.9-34.5 s for no credits. All eight checks reported healthy, watertight, 0 holes, 0 non-manifold edges and 0 degenerate faces; thin_area_ratio was 0 without the hole and 0.041-0.043 with either thread.

artifact_inspection.method: Local file byte count and SHA-256; binary STL triangle records parsed and merged into shared vertices with numpy, checked as a solid with manifold3d 3.5.4; thread radii measured from horizontal slices of the finished file along +X, pitch and handedness from the radius profile at 0 and 90 degrees.
artifact_inspection.note: Python run artifacts (pictured). model.stl is Meshy's mesh as delivered, Z-up with its longest side 1,902.92 units and no stated unit; it was manifold, so no gaps were closed. knob-8-32.stl and knob-M4.stl are the recipe's print files in millimetres: 38.00 x 38.00 x 31.12 mm, base on Z = 0, one manifold solid of genus 0. The 8-32 hole measures 1.795-2.232 mm in radius (modelled 1.804-2.233) with a 0.794 mm pitch; the M4 hole 1.763-2.148 mm (modelled 1.771-2.150) with a 0.700 mm pitch; both right-handed, 12 mm deep, with a 5.2 mm counterbore 1 mm deep, and at least 4.0 mm of plastic around the hole. The TypeScript run's model.stl had 122,642 triangles (6,132,184 bytes) and gave a 32.73 mm tall knob: knob-8-32.stl 208,746 triangles (10,437,384 bytes), knob-M4.stl 220,074 triangles (11,003,784 bytes). Model files are not published by this repository.
